decoder_grid.iteration_order: itertools.product(probabilities, repeat=2), each pair is (gate_probability, measurement_probability)

selection_source: outputs/prototype_development/data/calibration_evidence.npz, 20,000 independent calibration shots per regime; labels may select development decoders but are unavailable to runtime policy

evaluation.evaluation_seed_rule: 99500001 + 1000*regime_index + root_index; regime order data_heavy, nominal, measurement_heavy

analysis.primary_headroom: equal-regime LER(best-per-regime calibration-selected decoder) minus LER(best-global calibration-selected decoder)
